description.zh: 需要设置的键名称，最长不超过512个字符，不能包含空格、反斜杠（/）。
description.en: The name of the key to set. The key can be up to 512 characters in length and cannot contain spaces or backslashes (/).
The name of the namespace that you specified when you called the [PutDcdnKvNamespace](~~PutDcdnKvNamespace~~) operation.

description.zh: 存储有需要设置的键值对的下载链接，此参数由调用SDK时自动生成，请使用SDK进行调用。
description.en: The download URL of the object that stores the key-value pair. This parameter is automatically generated by the SDK. You must use an SDK to call this operation.

title.zh: 设置KV存储空间的单个大容量键值对

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn put-dcdn-kv-with-high-capacity --namespace test_namesapce --key test_key --url https://xxxobject.oss-cn-reginon.aliyuncs.com/9d91_xxxxxxxxxxx_158bb6e0f97c477791209bb46bd599f7 --region cn-hangzhou
